name: Professor Ved
description: The channel's explainer. Mid 20s, muscular-fit and compact (broad chest and shoulders, strong arms). Black hair: short textured top with a skin fade on the sides and nape. Groomed stubble beard joined to the moustache (denser around the mouth and chin, clean cheek line), no glasses. Formal-boss-casual: crisp white shirt, top button open, sleeves rolled below the elbow, black trousers, black belt, black shoes, gold watch on his left wrist. Semi-realistic 2D, bright and clean, warm key light from the left.
